executive_summary.conclusion: Three inspected source pages clearly explain Willow Clay Studio’s classes, eligibility, prices and booking conditions, with no verified discoverability or source-route defects in this sample. Browser behavior, independent corroboration and actual assistant citations were not tested.

not_checked: Rendered content, interactive controls, mobile layout, keyboard access, focus and overlays were not checked because browser access is unavailable.
External search and independent corroboration of the studio identity, address and accessibility claims were unavailable.
Email handling, live place availability, payment and booking confirmation were not tested; no contact was made.
Actual assistant answer/citation runs, indexing, provider IP access and behavioral metrics were not measured.

readiness.detail: Published wildcard robots policy allows the inspected paths; all three source HTML pages returned 200 without captured noindex directives. This establishes observed source access and policy, not actual indexing or assistant citation.
Complete captured static text supplies class variants, prices, dates, prerequisites, cancellation and booking conditions; all three pages have meta descriptions. No rendered comparison was available.
All three prospective-student questions are answered by the inspected first-party text; the site explicitly distinguishes a booking request from a confirmed place.
First-party descriptions identify Willow Clay Studio in Bristol consistently; independent sources could not be checked because external search is unavailable.

Two source information routes reach relevant class and booking instructions through labeled links. Browser interaction and email execution remain untested; the captured pages expose no class-selection control whose state could be exercised.

intent_tests.question: What does Willow Clay Studio offer, where is it, and who can attend?

evidence.quote: We teach small-group pottery classes in Bristol for beginners and returning makers aged 16 and over.

intent_tests.reason: The homepage directly names pottery classes in Bristol, beginners and returning makers, and the minimum age of 16.

intent_tests.question: What are the beginner workshop date, price, prerequisites and cancellation terms?

evidence.quote: Beginner workshop For first-time makers aged 16 and over. Sunday 20 September 2026, 10:00–12:00 Europe/London. £45 per person for two hours, including clay, tools and firing. No experience or equipment needed.
Free cancellation until 48 hours before your session.

intent_tests.reason: The beginner section states the 20 September session, local time zone, £45 two-hour price, included materials and lack of prerequisites; the same page gives the 48-hour cancellation deadline.

intent_tests.question: How can a returning maker request a place and know when it is reserved?

evidence.quote: Returning-maker session For makers who have completed a beginner workshop.

Email hello@willow.example with your preferred class, date and number of participants. We reply within two working days to confirm availability and send payment instructions. Your place is reserved only after confirmation.

intent_tests.reason: The returning-maker section requires a completed beginner workshop. Booking instructions specify the email address, requested details, two-working-day reply window, and confirmation condition.

journeys.task: Read the beginner workshop eligibility, date and price
journeys.starting_context: A first-time pottery student aged at least 16 arrives at the homepage.

steps.action: [source] Inspect the Choose a pottery class link and its destination.
steps.observation: The labeled link resolves to /classes/, which was fetched successfully.

steps.action: [source] Read the beginner workshop section in the fetched class page.
steps.observation: The section states the age requirement, 20 September morning session, £45 price and included clay, tools and firing.

journeys.reason: The source information route reaches the requested beginner details. Completion describes reading a fetched destination; browser clicking was not tested.

journeys.task: Find booking instructions for a returning-maker session
journeys.starting_context: A returning maker compares the listed session and wants to request a place.

steps.action: [source] Inspect returning-maker prerequisites and the Contact us to request a place link.
steps.observation: The prerequisite is completion of a beginner workshop; the booking link points to /visit/#booking.

steps.action: [source] Read the fetched visit page’s booking instructions.
steps.observation: The page supplies the email address, required class/date/participant details and confirmation process.

journeys.reason: The public instructions are readable at the linked visit page. No email was sent; anchor scrolling, mail-client behavior and reservation completion are untested. No selectable class control was captured, so selected-state retention was not applicable to this source route.

visibility.detail: No recorded assistant answer runs; crawl checks are not citation measurements.
